turns.manual_says: Engine removal (5-2) starts with draining transmission oil, then seat/fuel tank, carburetor, exhaust, radiator; 5-4 tip: support swingarm with a shaft when pivot shaft is pulled.
Changing transmission oil (3-6/3-7): warm engine several minutes, wait five minutes, stand level, remove oil drain bolt and filler cap, drain; refit with new aluminum washer.
turns.what_is_wrong: Says drain with engine cold; manual 3-6 step 1 warms engine several minutes and waits five minutes first (minor for a teardown).

turns.manual_says: Changing the coolant (3-11/3-12): cold engine, rag over cap; procedure removes coolant drain bolt first, then slowly loosens radiator cap; refit drain bolt with new copper washer at 10 N·m.
turns.what_is_wrong: Order reversed vs 3-11 (manual: drain bolt, then cap); otherwise correct.

turns.manual_says: Seat, air scoops, side covers (4-1); side cover drawn backward because claws sit in air filter case (4-2); fuel tank removal removes fuel cock assembly, O-ring, tank, 2 breather hoses (7-1).
turns.what_is_wrong: Manual 7-1 removes the fuel cock assembly from the tank (not hose at carburetor) and lists 2 breather hoses; minor.

turns.manual_says: Install new greased O-rings and dowels, head, new copper washers, nuts 28 N·m tightened in stages crisscross (5-15); head stud 13 N·m (2-10).

Bore 54.000–54.014, limit 54.064, C = max of 6 readings (5-9); piston 53.957–53.972 at 17.5 mm, clearance 0.040–0.045 (5-10); ring side 0.035–0.070/limit 0.100, end gap limit 1.20 (5-11); pin/bore limits and 0.008–0.023 clearance, limit 0.065 (5-11/5-12); no taper/out-of-round figure in manual.
turns.what_is_wrong: All values correct; omits pin-to-bore clearance limit 0.065 mm (5-12). Manual gives no taper/out-of-round limit, so 'not confirmed' is acceptable.

turns.manual_says: Exhaust removal (5-1): right side cover, washers, silencer, collars, grommets, 2 tension springs, exhaust pipe.
turns.what_is_wrong: Says carburetor next; 5-2 lists carburetor before exhaust (harmless order difference).

turns.manual_says: Ring installed near cylinder bottom levelled with piston crown; end gap limit 1.20 mm, replace ring if out (5-11); manual gives only a limit.

Break-in premix YAMALUBE 2R 15:1, warm 1–2 min, ~20 min at ≤1/2 throttle, pit stop, ~40 min at ≤3/4 (1-18); cylinder/crank ~1 hour, piston/ring/gear ~30 min ≤1/2 (1-19); after break-in change transmission oil, check chips (1-20); normal premix 30 (2-2).
